transition.$description: A duration, delay and easing for one kind of change. A transition token names no CSS property, so a component lists the properties it animates, for example `transition: color var(--transition-tint), background-color var(--transition-tint)`. Add a token per scene as components need one.

tint.$description: Background, text and border color on a control.

surface.$description: Background, border and shadow on a surface such as the nav bar or a card.
